question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
SELECT 
    pn.pizza_name,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12.0
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10.0
            ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(co.extras, '') = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(co.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(co.extras, ',', '')) + 1)
        END
    ) as revenue
FROM pizza_customer_orders co
JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders cro ON co.order_id = cro.order_id
WHERE pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
  AND (cro.cancellation IS NULL OR cro.cancellation = '')
GROUP BY pn.pizza_name
